title: DINOv2 capacity-complementary score selector development
role: episode-1 method development after PAT-J-260729-001 failed its strict 1pp screen but established B/L error complementarity

base_classifiers.score_source: default OVR decision_function with class columns verified against model.classes_

ccss_bank.zscore_fusion: row-zscored B/L decision scores with L weights 0.1 through 0.9
ccss_bank.rank_fusion: descending per-class B/L ranks with L weights 0.1 through 0.9
ccss_bank.confidence_route: retain B prediction unless L zscore-margin exceeds B zscore-margin by thresholds 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, or 1.0
ccss_bank.selection: four-fold inner OOF within every outer-training split
ccss_bank.tie_breaking: higher inner BA, then fewer switches from B, then lower-complexity fixed order

screen_gate.on_success: freeze score-selector algorithm and run untouched episodes 2 and 3
screen_gate.on_fail: retain PAT-J-001 as a positive but sub-threshold method signal; do not add more episode-1 selector families
